title: EVA pre-breathe protocol
body: Crew must perform 4-hour overnight campout at 10.2 psia (or equivalent N2-purge protocol) before EMU EVA to prevent decompression sickness (DCS). Skipping pre-breathe is contingency-only and triggers post-EVA medical observation.

title: Maximum EMU O2 consumption
body: EMU primary O2 budget covers 6.5 hours plus 30-min reserve. If consumption rate suggests budget exceeded, crewmate transfers to buddy-O2 via dual-tether or returns immediately. Mission rule: never let one crew solely depend on EVA-task O2 < 1 hour reserve.

title: Glove leak during EVA
body: Visible glove damage or measurable suit pressure leak: 1. Sister crew tethers to leaking crew. 2. Tether-relief return path planned. 3. Hand-over-hand return to airlock; primary tether kept attached. 4. EMU-suit-replacement kit deployed in airlock.
citation: STS-118 EVA glove leak; JSC anomaly report

title: Tether redundancy
body: EVA crew shall always be tethered with two independent paths. SAFER (Simplified Aid For EVA Rescue) jetpack carried but reserved for total tether loss; never used as primary means.
